title: F44 · the_dark · The Thing Under the Bed
lines: Something is under her bed. She is sure.
She called for Mummy three times already.
The cupboard door is open one inch. That is worse.
She pulled the blanket over her head and squeezed her eyes shut.
Something warm sat down on her feet.
That one under the bed? He is ours, said the calf. (Only Pari heard.)
"That one under the bed? He is ours," said the calf. (Only Pari heard.)
He sits above every temple door. His whole job is scaring the scary things.
"He sits above every temple door. His whole job is scaring the scary things."
Pari leaned over the edge. Hello.
She slept with one hand hanging down, in case he got lonely.
Not everything in the dark is against you. Some of it is on guard. That is sadhana.
